description.summary: protocol for creating xdg_toplevel icon subjects

protocol.description: This protocol allows clients to create jay_icon_surface_subject_v1 objects from xdg_toplevel objects.

interface.name: jay_toplevel_icon_subject_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface is a singleton global.

request.name: destroy
request.description:
This request destroys the object.
This has no effect on any created subjects.

request.name: create_subject
request.description:
This request creates a jay_icon_surface_subject_v1 object that references an xdg_toplevel.
For the purpose of the jay_icon_surface_manager_v1.create_factory request, assigning an xdg_toplevel_icon_v1 icon to the toplevel counts as creating a jay_icon_surface_factory_v1 for the toplevel. Therefore, these two APIs should not be used concurrently on the same toplevel.
